summary: CareView Communications filed an 8-K reporting entry into the Sixteenth Amendment to its Credit Agreement and creation of a direct financial obligation. The amendment, dated October 7, 2026, extends the maturity date of the existing credit facility with PDL Investment Holdings, LLC, as administrative agent and lender, and follows dozens of prior amendments dating back to the original June 26, 2015 Credit Agreement. No pricing, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation was disclosed. This is a routine debt-amendment current report, not a special situation, though persistent reliance on serial extensions signals ongoing liquidity stress worth monitoring.
